gold: Acute dacryocystitis with secondary optic nerve injury

selector.rationale: Orbital cellulitis best explains the edematous, hyperemic left eyelids and left orbital pain, with supportive imaging findings of postseptal fat stranding and globe compression.

rejected.label: Dacryocystitis
rejected.why: Lack of prior dacryocystitis and presence of more severe orbital symptoms

rejected.label: Lacrimal sac abscess
rejected.why: While present, it is a component of the more comprehensive diagnosis of orbital cellulitis
